rows.name: ENTER_PRESENTER_RVA (PresenterManager open)
rows.method: the old body changed enough that no masked window maps it, so: the first 20 bytes of the old function occur exactly once in the new .text, at a .pdata function start (0x135b4f0); that function has the same shape (scan the presenter stack [mgr+0x14 .. +0x14+4*[mgr+0x28]] for the requested id, log "trying to reopen (%s) that is already showing" with the same PresenterManager name table, else close the current presenter [mgr+0xc] and tail-jump to the open routine). New in 26088801: a check [mgr+0x10] != 0 that logs "change_menu(%s) ignored: a popup is active" and returns without opening (a game-side guard; harmless for the mod, which re-reads the current presenter after the call). Calling convention and arguments (manager, presenter id, extra) are unchanged; the 16-byte prologue the mod checks is identical.

The intro phase setter (old 0x146ac60 -> new 0x13028b0, aligned 1:1) writes phase and timer, and the intro step (old 0x1465c5e -> new 0x12fd88e) loads timer = table[phase] from an identical float table (-1, 2.0, 0.15, ...): phase 1 waits 2.0 s, so writing 0.0 to the timer while phase = 1 ends the wait exactly as before. Both fields are still the last two dwords before the object end (0x273a10 - 0x48).
